popup.title: Ravens Bluff
popup.description: The metropolis known as the '''Living City''', known for its industries, spectator sports, competitive events, gambling, and rich culture of arts.

popup.title: Hulburg
popup.description: A once small city on the northeastern shore of the [[Moonsea]], it regained a portion of its population in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]], following ruination that lasted several decades.

popup.title: Ordulin
popup.description: The capital of [[Sembia]], destroyed in a planar rift summoned by [[Elyril Hraven]] in [[1484 DR]], rebuilt and proclaimed a capital once again by [[1499 DR]].

popup.title: Calaunt
popup.description: A city-state that grew out of the village of '''Vespermouth''' to become the largest and the most influential in [[the Vast]] by [[1372 DR]], only for the title to be reclaimed by [[Ravens Bluff]] by [[1479 DR]].

popup.title: Tantras
popup.description: A large and influential oligarchic city-state of [[the Vast]].

popup.title: Selgaunt
popup.description:
Once known as '''Chancelgaunt''', a major trade port city and the capital of [[Sembia]]. .

Interactive map can be found [[Map:Selgaunt|here]].

popup.title: Saerloon
popup.description: Once known as '''Chondathan''', an old [[Sembia]]n city known for its exotic tastes and gothic architecture, sprinkled throughout with [[gargoyle]]s and other decorations, and for its mercantile activity, seasoned by thievery and intrigue.

popup.title: Sundabar
popup.description: Also known as '''Citadel Sundbarr''', one of the wealthiest and most militaristic cities within the nation of [[Luruar]].

popup.title: Samargol
popup.description: The '''City of Veils''', the tropical capital city of [[Samarach]] that housed a quarter of the Samarachan population.

popup.title: Taruin
popup.description: The '''City of Seven Spices''', a large city that stood on the junction of the creeks that merged, forming the [[River Samar]], renowned for its [[spice]]s and [[salt]] production.

popup.title: Rassatan
popup.description: Or '''The City of Gilded Pearls''', a city atop a cliff of buildings carved into the walls of the [[Sanrach Basin]].

popup.title: Narubel
popup.description: Also known as '''The City of Seasnakes''', the city built into a series of sea caves that honeycombed the cliffs of a natural harbor.

popup.title: Delselar
popup.description: The '''City of Succulent Jewels''', a large unwalled city on the water.

popup.title: Lundeth
popup.description: Or the '''City of Whirring Waters''', a large city in the foothills of the [[Hazur Mountains]].

popup.title: Thindar
popup.description: A large unwalled city and the capital of [[Thindol]], sprawled across a filled-in marsh.

popup.title: Gurdeth
popup.description: Or the '''City of Stilts''', a small, regularly flooded city of buildings perched atop poles and tied to each other for stability.

popup.title: Everlund
popup.description: A city of merchant traders and caravan teams and was one of the greatest supporters of the league of the [[Silver Marches]].

popup.title: Menzoberranzan
popup.description: The '''City of Spiders''', located deep in the [[Underdark]].

popup.title: Yartar
popup.description: A fortified city member city of the [[Lords' Alliance]].

popup.title: Port Nyanzaru
popup.description: A port city and an [[Amn]]ian colony that gained independence in late 1480s [[DR]].

popup.title: Mezro
popup.description: The site of the great city of the [[Tabaxi (tribe)|Tabaxi humans]] of [[Chult]], transported to a pocket plane by its deity – [[Ubtao]] to protect it from the destruction of the [[Spellplague]].

popup.title: Ss'zuraass'nee
popup.description: '''The City of Abominations''', a large [[yuan-ti]] city in the [[Underdark]].

popup.title: Ss'essethen'aa
popup.description: A city of twisting tunnels inhabited by [[yuan-ti]] [[cleric]]s of [[Sseth]] and [[ophidian]] laborers.

popup.title: Ss'khanaja
popup.description: An [[Underdark]] city inhabited mainly by high-class [[naga]]s and their staff.

popup.title: Tsenviilyq
popup.description: A [[derro]] city in the [[Underdark]].

popup.title: Anchoril
popup.description: A port city of note.

popup.title: Illul
popup.description: The center of the faith of [[Gond]] in the [[Realms]] and the site of the [[High Holy Crafthouse of Inspiration]].

popup.title: Sambar
popup.description: The capital city of [[Lantan]].

popup.title: Sundrah
popup.description: A city of note.

popup.title: Gauntlgrym
popup.description: The capital of the [[Delzoun]], reclaimed and ruled by King [[Bruenor Battlehammer]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Tupaal
popup.description: An underwater city of note.

popup.title: Orilidren
popup.description: One of the Six Holy Cities of the [[ixitxachitl]] nation in the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] known as the [[Xedran Reefs]].

popup.title: Thuridru
popup.description: An underwater settlement of note.

popup.title: Grand Tor Arcanal
popup.description: The capital of the underwater [[kuo-toa]]n nation of [[Olleth]].

popup.title: Pumanath
popup.description: An underwater city, [[triton]] protectorate.

popup.title: Ahlorsath
popup.description: The capital of one of the three [[triton]] kingdoms in the [[Trench of Lopok]].

popup.title: Vuuvaxath
popup.description: The capital of one of the three [[triton]] kingdoms in the [[Trench of Lopok]].

popup.title: Us'rath
popup.description: An underwater city of note.

popup.title: Us'holm
popup.description: An underwater city of note.

popup.title: Mulptan
popup.description: The great vast, wind-battered trade city of [[Rashemen]], overflowing with tents and stalls.

popup.title: Immilmar
popup.description: The capital city of [[Rashemen]] and seat of power for the nation's [[Iron Lord]], famous for its great crafters, whose goods were renowned across the [[Unapproachable East]] and the [[Cold Lands]].

popup.title: Bildoobaris
popup.description: Also called '''the Trade Fair'', a large seasonal tent city and the unofficial capital of [[Narfell]] as of [[1479 DR]], that dominated the plains for one tenday each summer.

popup.title: Helgabal
popup.description: The metropolis formerly known as '''Heliogabalus''', once the seat of government until King [[Gareth]] moved the capital to [[Bloodstone Village]] in the mid-to-late 14{{th}} century [[DR]], and later, moved back to Helgabal in the mid-to-late 15{{th}} century DR.

popup.title: Trailsend
popup.description: The capital of the [[Barony of Polten]] – the center for travel of the surrounding region, and appealed to adventuring parties looking for work or seeking to explore the ruins in [[Rawlinswood]] or the [[Giantspire Mountains]].

popup.title: Praka
popup.description: One of the larger cities in the [[Barony of Ostel]] in [[Damara]], known for its stout outer walls and mighty towers.

popup.title: Velen
popup.description: A port city on the [[Tethyrian Peninsula]], overlooking the [[Sea of Swords]], that served as the capital of the duchy of [[Cape Velen]], within the [[Kingdom of Tethyr]] in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]] and onward into the 15{{th}} century after the realm's independence was declared.

popup.title: Darromar
popup.description: The metropolis formerly known as '''Ithmong''' and '''Calimaronn'''.

popup.title: Erebos
popup.description: A large city on the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] that could call up 8,000 troops and had a large fleet of ships with 5,000 marine soldiers.

popup.title: Hammerstaad
popup.description: A fortified [[Northlander]] city and the seat of power for the king of [[Norheim]].

popup.title: Gnarhelm
popup.description: The capital city of the kingdom of [[Gnarhelm]].

popup.title: Caer Callidyrr
popup.description: The capital city of the [[Ffolk]] people on the [[Moonshaes island]] of [[Alaron]], and an [[alabaster]] castle that rose high above the settlement.

popup.title: Darmshall
popup.description: A small commercial hub city in the hostile lands of [[Vaasa]] surrounded by farmland and ranches.

popup.title: Palischuk
popup.description: A city in the northeastern corner of [[Vaasa]] populated predominantly by [[half-orc]]s.

popup.title: Telos City
popup.description: The largest and newest city in [[Vaasa]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]] that served as the realm's capital and the seat of power for the [[Warlock Knights]].

popup.title: Kressilacc
popup.description: A [[sahuagin]] city in the [[Sea of Moonshae]], off the east coast of [[Oman's Isle]], the north coast of [[Gwynneth]], and the west coast of [[Alaron]].

popup.title: Blackalblade
popup.description: A small city and the capital of [[Ondeeme]], one of the wealthiest cities in the [[Border Kingdoms]] famed for its [[gem]]cutters.

popup.title: Oeble
popup.description:
A well-known trade center and a haven for criminal activity in the region – a place built on the bones of betrayed men.

Interactive map can be found [[Map:Oeble|here]].

popup.title: Tirumala
popup.description: Also known as the '''Holy City''' of the [[rakshasa]]s, a rich city-state built atop [[Durpari]] ruins. It was a trading partner of [[Estagund]] by [[1474 DR]].

popup.title: Underhome
popup.description: The surface entrance into the '''Great City of the Dwarves''', the capital city of the [[Deep Realm]] of the [[gold dwarves]] located within the [[Great Rift]].

popup.title: Rogarsheim
popup.description: The [[Northlander]] capital located on the [[Bay of Norland]], with its industry centered around [[fish]]ing, hunting, and shipbuilding.

popup.title: Caer Corwell
popup.description: Also known as '''Corwell Town''', a small city and a castle of the same name.

popup.title: Sorath-Nu-Sum
popup.description: A city – the center of [[kuo-toa]] politics in the [[Underdark]].

popup.title: Caer Westphal
popup.description: A fortified castle that overlooked the city of Westphal on [[Snowdown Ride]].

popup.title: Synnoria
popup.description: An ancient [[elf|elven]] kingdom hidden in the mountains bordering the [[Myrloch Vale]] and sheltered by a powerful ''mass illusion'' [[spell]].

popup.title: Us'holm
popup.description: An underwater city of note.

popup.title: Karador
popup.description: A small [[fey]] city located in the middle of the [[Myrloch]].

popup.title: Anhaurz
popup.description: A city that was melted down overnights in the [[Spellplague]] and was rebuilt into a fortress city with a massive garrison by [[1478 DR]].

popup.title: Djerad Thymar
popup.description: Thr citadel-city of [[Tymanther]] and its [[Abeir]]an [[dragonborn]], brought to [[Toril]] by the [[Spellplague]].

popup.title: Skalnaedyr
popup.description: The second-largest city in [[Murghôm]], formerly known as '''Phannaskul the Iron'''.

popup.title: Port Ghaast
popup.description: A large city in [[Murghôm]] that stood along the western bank of the [[River Ghaast]] and a prime military location for incursions into neighboring [[Semphar]].

popup.title: Zindalankh
popup.description: A coastal caravan city of [[Murghôm]] and the site of a large [[Shou]] Town.

popup.title: Dhaztanar the Crystal-Towered
popup.description: The capital city of [[Semphar]] that stood on one end of the [[Silk Road]], making it a bustling epicenter of trade and commerce.

popup.title: Semlithol
popup.description: A major coastal city in [[Semphar]].

popup.title: Black Ash Plain
popup.description: A wasteland of black volcanic ash, home to [[brown dragon]]s and [[ash giant]]s.

popup.title: Plains of Purple Dust
popup.description: A windy desert located east of the [[Dragonsword Mountains]].

popup.title: Raurin
popup.description: The '''Dust Desert'' and the '''Desert of Desolation'', once the center of the ancient empire of [[Imaskar]].

popup.title: Bandit Wastes
popup.description: An expanse of barrens or badlands between [[Lapaliiya]] and [[Halruaa]], home to monsters, among them were [[giant ants]], which dug a warren of tunnels beneath the barrens.

popup.title: Calim Desert
popup.description: The rocky desert on the coast of [[Calimshan]], formed by an epic magical war between two [[genie]]s, the [[djinni]] [[Calim]] and [[efreeti]] [[Memnon]].

popup.title: Teshyllal Wastes
popup.description: The desert wastelands surrounding the ruins of the ancient city of [[Teshyll]].

popup.title: Hordelands
popup.description: '''The Endless Wastes''' or '''Taan''', the land of  horsemen tribes, most notably the [[Tuigan]]s.

popup.title: Singing Sands
popup.description: The site of the [[1194 DR]] event known as the [[Battle of the Singing Sands]] between [[Aglarond]] and the [[Red Wizards of Thay]].

popup.title: Stonelands
popup.description: A rocky and hilly region of harsh beauty marked by knife-edged ridges, deep ravines, caverns, and overhangs.

popup.title: Anauroch
popup.description: Also known as '''The Great Sand Sea''', a magical desert in [[northern Faerûn]] created my a calamity in [[10 DR]].

popup.title: The Cold Field
popup.description: A flat, treeless moor permanently scarred by [[dragon's breath]] and haunted by [[ghost]]s of long-dead soldiers.

popup.title: The Burn
popup.description: Once a [[goblin]]-infested forest, incinerated with magic into a stretch of barren land between the [[Shaddan Hills]] to the [[Hunters' Hills]].

popup.title: The Quarter of Emptiness
popup.description: The last remnant of the [[Anauroch]] in the century after the [[Spellplague]]. The region returned to its former state in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Moander's Footstep
popup.description: The region of the dessert that housed a river and a swamp in the century that followed the [[Spellplague]] and reverted to its desert state in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Tortured Land
popup.description: A barren area in the northernmost [[Moonsea]] region, inhabited by [[Ondonti]] [[orc]]s who followed the teachings of of [[Eldath]], the Goddess of Peace and Quiet Places.

popup.title: Nsi Wastes
popup.description: A stretch of blighted poisonous jungle and cut down trees.

popup.title: The Fallen Lands
popup.description: A barren area of the [[Savage Frontier]], home to many monsters and even more mysteries. In the mid-to-late 14{{th}} century [[DR]], it was beset with ''[[dead-magic]]'' zones, areas of ''[[wild magic]]'' and random discharges of ''[[witchfire]]''.

popup.title: Valley of Embers
popup.description: A barren lowland covered in lava flows that spewed out of the [[Peaks of Flame]], the sky above was choked with clouds of ash and dotted with blazing cinders.

popup.title: Valley of Lost Honor
popup.description: Once the last refuge of the [[Eshowe]] tribe before they were wiped out by [[Ras Nsi]].

popup.title: Land of Ash and Smoke
popup.description: The area of the jungle, scorched by volcanic activity, south of the [[Peaks of Flame]].

popup.title: Blackfeather Barrens
popup.description: The area of the [[Beastlands]] that stretched between the [[Toadsquat Mountains]] and the [[Curna Mountains]].

popup.title: Cinnabar Wastes
popup.description: A region of cold and arid badlands in northeast [[Vaasa]] named for the reddish color of the local rock formations.

popup.title: At'ar's Looking Glass
popup.description: A sweltering and uniquely hazardous stretch of desert – a flat "sea" of small, multi-color polished stones that absorbed more heat from the sun than any other surface in [[Anauroch]].

popup.title: Bowl of Loneliness
popup.description: A great dune field located in [[the Sword]], between the oases of [[El Rahalat]] and [[El Ma'ra]].

popup.title: The Saiyaddar
popup.description: A region of [[Anauroch]] used as the "hunting grounds" of the [[Bedine]] [[human]]s.

popup.title: The Sword
popup.description: One of the three major regions of [[Anauroch]] – a hot, sandy region most thought of when someone mentioned the Great Desert.

popup.title: Hills of Scent
popup.description: A large grouping of sandy stone hills found in [[the Sword]] region of [[Anauroch]].

popup.title: The Plain of Standing Stones
popup.description: The central region of [[Anauroch]] where winds abraded jagged rocks that stood in the middle of a sea of gravel.

popup.title: Nunwood
popup.description: The main source of lumber for [[Reth]] and [[Hlath]], protected by the [[Emerald Enclave]] and creatures that used hit-and-run tactics during the night.

popup.title: Chondalwood
popup.description: Also known as the '''Satyrwood''', the large forest was located in [[Chondath]] in the [[Vilhon Reach]], stretching from the [[Nunwood]] to the [[Nagaflow River]]. It is also known as Satyrwood.

popup.title: Maerchwood
popup.description: The forest in the southern heartlands of [[Chessenta]], between the [[Adder River]] and the [[Winding River]].

popup.title: Methwood
popup.description: A dense forest located in the frontier between the nations of [[Chessenta]] and [[Unther]].

popup.title: Sharawood
popup.description: A haunted forest also knoen as the '''Drakewood''', located along the coast of the [[Gulf of Luiren]], overrun with monsters and [[undead]].

popup.title: Riftwood
popup.description: An isolated forest located about 50 miles (80.5 kilometers) east of the [[Great Rift]], home to a variety of animals and beasts, including [[snake]]s, [[panther]]s, and [[giant beetle]]s.

popup.title: Ganathwood
popup.description: A small forest found in the northern regions of [[Murghôm]], a minor source of wood for [[Mulhorand]], exporting it to [[Thay]].

popup.title: Aerilpar Forest
popup.description: Or the '''Wood of Dark Trees''' a monster-infested forest rumored to have its trees animated by a foul [[wizard]].

popup.title: Gundar Forest
popup.description: A small forest at the mouth of the [[River Gundar]].

popup.title: Lluirwood
popup.description: Also known as the '''Long Fores'''. It spanned 300 miles (480 km) east to west across [[Luiren]] and was roughly 90 miles (145 km) wide.

popup.title: Southern Lluirwood
popup.description: Or the '''Granuin Forest''', a mostly untamed wood, although the eastern border was patrolled by militia and [[halfling]] [[ranger]]s and [[druid]]s.

popup.title: Forest of Amtar
popup.description: A lush forest of heat and humidity, majority of which trees were [[suthwood]]. The dangerous woods were filled with [[choke creepers]], [[assassin vines]], [[roper]]s, and [[giant rhinoceros beetle]]s among other creatures.

popup.title: Duskwood
popup.description: The deepest and most untamed forest in the [[Border Kingdoms]] between the [[Realm of the Smoking Star]] and the [[Realm of the Ready Sword]].

popup.title: Shaarwood
popup.description: A small forest found in the western [[Shaar]].

popup.title: Channathwood
popup.description: A small forest found in the southern [[Shaar]].

popup.title: Misty Vale
popup.description: A hot, dense jungle east of the [[Dun Hills]] and north of the [[Bandit Wastes]], home to predatory horrors descended from [[Ilythiiri]] [[sorcerer]]s' castoff experiments.

popup.title: Shaareach Forest
popup.description: A small forest found in the southern [[Shaar]] near the plains of the [[Shaareach]].

popup.title: Mhair Jungles
popup.description: A prominent jungle forest found in southern [[Tashalar]] on the [[Chultan Peninsula]].

popup.title: Neth Stand
popup.description: A dark, thick forest on the [[Lake of Steam]] that contained underground volcanic vents that emitted sulfurous mists.

popup.title: Black Jungles
popup.description: A heavily forested region of southern [[Tashalar]].

popup.title: Ankhwood
popup.description: A forest whose insect, animal, and plant populations mutated by ''[[wild magic]]'' and ''[[dead magic]]'' areas orbiting one another.

popup.title: Winterwood
popup.description: A [[pine]] and [[oak]]-filled woodland inhabited by [[orc]]s, [[green dragon]]s, and [[green elves]].

popup.title: Thornwood
popup.description: The forest to the north of the city of [[Ankhapur]], known for its deadly flora - [[thornslinger]]s, [[choke creeper]]s, [[retch plant]]s, [[yellow musk creeper]]s, and many more dangerous and more intelligent plants.

popup.title: Qurth Forest
popup.description: A wild forest that bordered the forest with the [[Barony of the Great Oak]], surrounded by many towns and ruins.

popup.title: Jundarwood
popup.description: A forest of note in the [[Border Kingdoms]].

popup.title: Forest of Lethyr
popup.description: One of the two forests that comprised the borders of the [[Great Dale]], guarded by [[druid]]s and [[ranger]]s as well as a few [[treant]]s.

popup.title: Gray Forest
popup.description: Also known as the '''Tsurlar Forest''' with circles of the grand, gray-barked [[tree]]s with dark leaves that the [[moon elves]] who once dwelt here had turned themselves into.

popup.title: Yuirwood
popup.description: The ancient forest at the center of the nation of [[Aglarond]], named after the [[Yuir]], an ancient race of [[star elves]] who once dwelled in the forest.

popup.title: Border Forest
popup.description: Also known as the '''Rystall Woos''', a large forest of [[pine]]s, [[oak]]s, and other deciduous trees with thick hard-to-traverse undergrowth, inhabited mostly by [[fey]].

popup.title: Forest of Tethir
popup.description: Also known as [[Wealdath]], the largest forest in the [[Lands of Intrigue]] and the "single most important thing" that set the culture of [[Tethyr]].

popup.title: Duskwood Dell
popup.description: The most sacred site of [[Eldath]] located in [[Faerûn]].

popup.title: Snakewood
popup.description: A relatively small forest located in eastern [[Amn]], named after a great number of black and green [[snake]]s that lived there.

popup.title: High Forest
popup.description: A a vast forested remnant of the days of old, when all of [[Faerûn]] was covered in green and [[elves]], [[giant]]s, and [[dragon]]s ruled the world.

popup.title: Swanmay's Glade
popup.description: A portion of the [[Wealdath]] forest where the [[Nebulae Pool]] and the [[Calathalureenteir]] could be found.

popup.title: Moonglade
popup.description: Or the '''Seeding Forest''' as of the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Syldritch Trea
popup.description:
Ancient trees within the [[Shilmista]] forest, once menaced by evil [[wizard]] [[Dorigen Kel Lamond]] in [[1361 DR]].

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Shilmista
popup.description:
Or the '''Forest of Shadows''' that encompassed the kingdom of the [[wild elf]] [[Elbereth]].

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Bowgentle's Grove
popup.description:
A calm glade in the south of the forest and the burial place of the [[wizard]] [[Bowgentle]].

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Cloak Wood
popup.description: An ancient, thickly grown forest in the [[Western Heartlands]], infested by [[giant spider]]s, [[korred]]s, [[kampfult]]s, [[quickling]]s, [[satyr]]s, [[stirge]]s, and other deadly creatures.

popup.title: Hullack Forest
popup.description: A forest that was once a part of the huge forest of [[Cormanthor]].

popup.title: Wood of Sharp Teeth
popup.description: Or '''Glimmerwood''', a dense forest where one could gather [[maiden's milk]] and [[bellows root]] [[herb]]s, inhabited by  [[satyr]]s, [[dryad]]s, and a small number of [[werewolves]].

popup.title: Hermit's Wood
popup.description: A large forest in southern [[Cormyr]], lying southwest of [[Wheloon]] – a common destination for foragers, hunters, and loggers.

popup.title: The Redwoods
popup.description: A. small forest at the [[River Arabel]]'s begging on the edge of the [[Helmhands]].

popup.title: King's Forest
popup.description: The forest that belonged to the Crown of [[Cormyr]], once home to [[elves]] but abandoned to humankind.

popup.title: Misty Forest
popup.description: A fog-filled, rainy forest, west of the [[High Moor]], that was also an [[elf|elven]] kingdom.

popup.title: Reaching Woods
popup.description: A large forest in the [[Western Heartlands]] with its northern offshoot being called the '''Northdark Wood'''.

popup.title: Forest of Wyrms
popup.description: Also known as '''Ss'kowlyn'raa'' by the [[yuan-ti]], a dark and dangerous forest of  [[pine]]s and tall [[redwood]] [[tree]]s.

popup.title: South Wood
popup.description: A forest within the [[Triangle of Trees]] in the [[Savage Frontier]], a popular stomping grounds for the outdoorsmen of [[Gray Vale]].

popup.title: Tanglefork Woods
popup.description: A small forest in the [[Grayvale]], at the southwestern fringe of the great [[High Forest]], between it and the [[River Delimbiyr]] and the [[Delimbiyr Road]] and just east of the [[Heartblood River]] where it joined the Delimbiyr.

popup.title: Forgotten Forest
popup.description: A small but mysterious forest of [[treant]]s and [[fey]] creatures found in the [[Backlands]] of the [[Western Heartlands]].

popup.title: Gulthmere Forest
popup.description: The forest that served as the rough boundary between the [[Dragon Coast]] and the [[Vilhon Reach]]. Overgrown with [[pine]] and [[cedar]], it was the "seat of power" for the Vilhonese [[druid]]s.

popup.title: Troll Claw Woods
popup.description: A small forested area of the [[Troll Claws]] infested with giant [[boring beetle|boring]] and [[bombardier beetle]]s, [[monstrous humanoid]]s, [[giant spider]], and, of corse, [[troll]]s.

popup.title: Coast Way Forest
popup.description: A minor forested area west of the [[Coast Way crossing]].

popup.title: Bloodbark Grove
popup.description: A grove of [[blackthorn tree]]s and [[belladonna]] plants in the southern stretch of the [[High Moor]], inhabited by greater [[basilisk]]s, [[dire wolves|dire]], as well as [[dread wolves]].

popup.title: Trollbark Forest
popup.description: A forest with low vales that hid a multitude of bogs and swamps, inhabited by [[giant slug]]s, [[fell troll]]s, and [[choker]]s.

popup.title: Brush of Barbs
popup.description: A secluded and thorny overgrown forest, home of [[Govan Irfandel|Irfandel]]'s druidic [[Stone Circle of Govan]].

popup.title: Dancing Forest
popup.description: A small forest that grew along the [[Turmway]] and sheltered the town of [[Centaur Bridge]], notable for its seemingly permanent thick white mist.

popup.title: The Faraway
popup.description: A great forest in [[Turmish]].

popup.title: Ardeep Forest
popup.description: Or the '''Faraway Forest''', a small but thick woodland that once encompassed much of the [[Sword Coast]], famed for its legendary [[Cloud palace|floating towers]].

popup.title: Laughing Hollow
popup.description: A preternatural valley upriver from [[Daggerford]], filled with trees so dense, they created a day's twilight underneath.

popup.title: Spiderhaunt Wood
popup.description: A dangerous forest where spellcasters of all types came to gather [[spider]]-related [[spell component]]s.

popup.title: Quivering Forest
popup.description: A forest stretching from the city of [[Phlan]] to the [[Dragonspine Mountains]], forming a border with the great gray waste of [[Thar]].

popup.title: Westwood
popup.description: A part of a group of forests referred to by some as the [[Other Woods]] and others as the [[Moonwoods]].The forests in this group were [[Lurkwood]], [[Southkrypt Garden]], [[Southwood]], [[Moonwood]], and [[Westwood]].

popup.title: Kryptgarden Forest
popup.description: Also known as '''Tsordvudd''', was a small but ancient and foreboding forest, once a site that once housed long-lost realms of the [[elves]] and [[dwarves]].

popup.title: Adhe Wood
popup.description: A forest infected with numerous arachnid monsters.

popup.title: Brynwood
popup.description: The forest that covered a large area between the [[Earthfast Mountains]] and the [[North Road]], lying north of the towns of [[Maerstar]] and [[Sevenecho]].

popup.title: Velarswood
popup.description: A forest near the center of [[Harrowdale]] with a temple to [[Eilistraee]] located in the north, which was guarded by a number of goodly [[drow]].

popup.title: Highbank Forest
popup.description:
A steeply sloped and wooded hill that laid just to the north of the Highbank Forest
Village; it provided shelter to the village against the strongest winter winds.

popup.title: Monarch's Fall Glade
popup.description: The part of [[Cormanthor]] where the [[green dragon|green]] [[dracolich]] named [[Dretchroyaster]] laired in the 1400s DR.

popup.title: The Darkwoods
popup.description: The part of [[Cormanthor]] infamous for the [[Darkwoods Massacre]] [[orc]]s and [[elves]] in [[335 DR]].

popup.title: Grove of Darkness
popup.description: A grove of note.

popup.title: Corellon's Glen
popup.description: A border portion of greater [[Cormanthor]].

popup.title: Tangled Vale
popup.description: A notable part of [[Cormanthor]].

popup.title: Arch Wood
popup.description: A dark and dense logging forest in [[Archendale]] filled with [[oak]]s, [[ash]]es, [[elm]]s, [[shadowtop]]s, and [[duskwood]]s.

popup.title: Stonewoods
popup.description: A small forest in [[Hunter's Hills]], on the edge of the [[Stonelands]].

popup.title: Orlath Wood
popup.description: Woods on the edge of the [[Great Sand Sea]].

popup.title: Vale of Lost Voices
popup.description: A sacred part of [[Cormanthor]] used as a burial place for honored [[elf]] [[warriors]] with [[Rauthauvyr's Road]] passing through the middle of it.

popup.title: Far Forest
popup.description: One of a group of three forests named the [[Triangle of Trees]]; it was full of small lakes, some of which had become stinking marshes infested by [[will-o'-wisp]]s and a few [[chuul]].

popup.title: Vordrorn Forest
popup.description: A small but dangerous forest of [[pine]] trees and muskeg bogs at the base of the [[Ice Mountains]].

popup.title: Cold Wood
popup.description: Or '''Glimmerwood''', a forest on the edge of the [[Silver Marches]] inhabited by [[barbarian]]s, [[ettin]]s, [[bebilith]]s, and various predatory beasts.

popup.title: Vercy Wood
popup.description: A forest of note on the border of the wider [[Ride]] and the Fallen Kingdom of [[Barze]].

popup.title: Samarlogh
popup.description: A dense and dangerous ruin-littered jungle that covered the northern rim of [[Samarach]], inhabited by [[corollax]]es and large carnivorous [[sloth]]s.

popup.title: Everwood
popup.description: Or '''Silverwood''', a small forest east of the [[Evermoors]].

popup.title: Weathercote Wood
popup.description: A forest of the [[Triangle of Trees]], located in the great expanse known as the [[Savage Frontier]] that existed from before the rise of [[Netheril]] and continued to endure despite the advancing of the desert of [[Anauroch]].

popup.title: The Dire Wood
popup.description: Also known as the '''Enchanted Wood''', an ancient and supernatural area within the [[High Forest]] found in the North.

popup.title: The Woods of Turlang
popup.description: A thicket located amongst the northwestern grouping of trees in the [[High Forest]], watched over by [[Turlang]], and over 100 other [[treant]]s.

popup.title: Tall Trees
popup.description: The northeastern section of the [[High Forest]] believed to contain the oldest [[tree]]s in the [[High Forest]].

popup.title: The Chultengar
popup.description: The branch of the main jungle of [[Chult]] that encroached on Thindol and Samarach, inhabited by [[spirit naga]]s, [[pterafolk]], [[wild dwarves]], [[wyvern]]s, and [[Batiri]].

popup.title: Charwood
popup.description: A southeastern portion of the [[Neverwinter Wood]].

popup.title: Neverwinter Wood
popup.description: Previously called '''Llewyrrwood''', a dense forest that possessed a sense of magic within it.

popup.title: Moonwood

popup.title: Lurkwood
popup.description: Also known as '''Vurykvudd''' in the [[dwarven]] tongue, home to the [[Thunderbeast tribe]] dwelled within the wood.

popup.title: Druarwood
popup.description: A hillside forest, sparse and narrow, full of [[pine]], [[spruce]] firs, and [[conifer]]s.

popup.title: Earthwood
popup.description: A thick and fertile swiftly-growing forest that grew out of stony, hilly soil, ensorcelled by an ancient [[druid]].

popup.title: Dunwood
popup.description: Also known as '''The Rawlinswood''' prior to [[1479 DR]], a large forest in the north of the [[Great Dale]].

popup.title: Fell Wood
popup.description: A small haunted monster-infested wood in the mountains of the [[Spine of the World]].

popup.title: Watcher's Forest
popup.description: The part of the [[Neverwinter Wood]], tended by some residents of nearby [[Helm's Hold]].

popup.title: Erech Forest
popup.description: A dark and isolated forest on the edge of [[Rashemen]], inhabited by [[assassin vine]]s and s[[hambling mound]]s, as well as fearsome beasts like [[owlbear]]s, [[night hunter]]s, and at least one [[gray render]].

popup.title: Denderdale
popup.description: The narrowest point in [[Dunwood]], sometimes used by travelers as a shortcut through the forest.

popup.title: Urlingwood
popup.description: A wild, untamed forest that was considered to be of great importance to the [[Wychlaran]].

popup.title: Ashenwood
popup.description: A wild evergreen forest known for its large number of [[fey]] inhabitants and considered a sacred site filled with ancient magic.

popup.title: Waukeshire

popup.title: Warrenwood

popup.title: Banshee's Point

popup.title: Downdragon Rise

popup.title: Old Stone Wood

popup.title: Greentree

popup.title: Halvan's Wood

popup.title: Mytharan Woods

popup.title: Torriage Wood

popup.title: Shannyth Forest
popup.description: A woodland that provided the village of [[Farview]] with timber for the construction of fine [[longship]]s.

popup.description: A small wood of note.

popup.description: A small forest of note.

popup.description: A small wood surrounded by farming hamlets.

popup.title: Urlingwood

popup.description: One of the watercourses of the [[Esmelflow]], used by the people of [[Keczulla]] to pan for [[gold]].

popup.title: Trifin Creek
popup.description: A swiftly flowing small river with steep banks that joined the [[Amstel River]] just past the city of [[Eshpurta]].

popup.title: River Rimril
popup.description: A river in eastern [[Amn]] that was a part of the [[Esmelflow]] and joined [[Trifin Creek]] just outside the city walls of [[Eshpurta]].

popup.title: Green Goddess Falls
popup.description: The beginning of the [[River Rimril]], that cascaded off the [[Troll Mountains]] into [[Duskwood Dell]]. Afterward, the waters continued cascading in a number of smaller falls and pools called the '''Steps'''.{{approx}}

popup.title: Splendarrllur
popup.description: Also known as the '''Shining River''' among the [[shield dwarves]]) was one of the three greatest rivers of [[Amn]].

popup.title: Akarav's Bay
popup.description: The northernmost bay of the [[Lake Esmel]] in [[Amn]] famed for its mineral springs that kept its waters warm and rejuvinating.

popup.title: Lake Esmel
popup.description: A famous lake in [[Amn]], the largest freshwater lake in the [[Lands of Intrigue]] with the "Monster of the Lake" residing in its depths.

popup.title: River Esmel
popup.description: A major waterway in [[Amn]], and "the true backbone of Amnian riches."

popup.title: Shimmalshyr
popup.description: A river that fed [[Lake Esmel]]'s southeast.

popup.title: Hyrzashyr
popup.description: A short river in [[Amn]] that fed [[Lake Esmel]] from the south, named during the existence of  the [[halfling]] kingdom of [[Meiritin]].

popup.title: Lake Weng
popup.description: A freshwater lake originally called the '''Lake of Amin'''. It was surrounded by small villages and fed by two rivers, eventually emptying into the [[Alandor River]].

popup.title: Alandor River
popup.description: A slow-moving and wide river of busy barge traffic.

popup.title: Amnurflow
popup.description: The northernmost of the tributaries of [[Lake Weng]], named after General [[Amnur]].

popup.title: Comassur Creek
popup.description: A small tributary of the [[Amnurflow]] river in [[Amn]], known for its fishing and [[salmon]] spawning seasons.

popup.title: Rashturiver
popup.description: A river that fed [[Lake Weng]] that had a waterfall near its source and had a twisted course.

popup.title: Wengwater
popup.description: A dangerously fast tributary of [[Lake Weng]] filled with deadly rapids.

popup.title: Tarseth Bay
popup.description: The bay on the [[Sea of Swords]] where [[Murann]] was built.

popup.title: River Chionthar
popup.description: A large and busy river that ran through the [[Western Heartlands]]. It supported trade as far inland as [[Iriaebor]].

popup.title: Sea of Swords
popup.description: A region of the [[Trackless Sea]] that separated the western coast of [[Faerûn]] from the [[Nelanther Isles]] and the [[Moonshae Isles]].

popup.title: River Specie
popup.description: The westernmost river in [[Amn]] – an important source of [[gold]].

popup.title: Imnestream
popup.description: One of the most beautiful rivers of the [[Sword Coast]]. Cold and swift, it passed through pleasant flower meadows and small clusters of trees. When it reached the floodplains, the waters became muddy, but before that, they were clean and pure.

popup.title: Merchant's Bay
popup.description: The bay at the mouth of [[Alandor River]].

popup.title: Firedrake Bay
popup.description: The scenic bay located between the [[Tethyr Peninsula|Tethyr]] and the [[Starspire Peninsula]]s, the habitat of [[star lobster]]s and the eponymous [[fire drake]]s on its southern shores.

popup.title: The Race
popup.description: A tract of water located off the southern edge of the [[Tethyr Peninsula]] in [[West Faerûn]] with merchant ships that sailed it being under the protection of the [[Calimshan]] navy.

popup.title: Bay of Bormul
popup.description: The bay on the southern side of the [[Starspire Peninsula]].

popup.title: Hawkwing's Brook
popup.description: Also known as '''Banshee's Brook''' or '''Tethir Brook''' – a tributary of the [[Sulduskoon River]] that flowed down through [[County Uluran]].

popup.title: Sulduskoon River
popup.description: A major spring-fed river in the kingdom of [[Tethyr]] named after the tribe of [[Suldusk]] [[elves]].

popup.title: Nebulae Pool
popup.description: Or the '''Pool of Stars'' – a peaceful forest lake on the northwestern end of the [[Swanmay's Glade]]. A lone [[swanmay]] once lived on the lake but was belied gone or dead by the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Calathalureenteir
popup.description: The forest river that crossed [[Swanmay's Glade]].

popup.title: River Valashar
popup.description: A river in the region of the former kingdom of the same name. The river began in the lower peaks of the [[Snowflake Mountains]] and cascaded down in three sets of waterfalls into a deep forest pool, before flowing northwest towards [[Trollford]].

popup.title: Shining Stream
popup.description: The primary tributary of the [[River Ith]] began in the [[Snowflake Mountains]].

popup.title: Swimstar Creek
popup.description:
A tributary of the [[Shining Stream]], which in turn was a tributary of [[Tethyr]]'s [[River Ith]]. It began in the [[Kuldin Peaks]].

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Impresk Lake
popup.description:
An ice-cold lake in [[Erlkazar]] fed by a large number of rivers and streams.

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Khalleshyr
popup.description: One of the rivers of the [[Esmelflow]] and a major tributary of the [[Amstel River]].

popup.title: Trollstooth Run
popup.description: A creek that began in the [[Qadim Hills]] and served as the eastern branch of the upper river [[Khalleshyr]].

popup.title: Fireflow
popup.description: Also known as the '''Gaping Stream''', an icy cold creek that began at the [[Gaping Face Cascade]] and served as the western branch of the upper [[Khalleshyr]] river.

popup.title: Gaping Face Cascade
popup.description: A waterfall that burst from a spring in the side of a rock face in the [[Troll Mountains]] and was the start of the [[Gaping Stream]].

popup.title: Shalane River
popup.description:
The short river that flowed from [[Impresk Lake]] to [[Shalane Lake]]. The river was suitable for travel by experienced boaters.

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Lake of Snows
popup.description: A placid lake situated in the eastern reaches of the [[Giant's Run Mountains]], overlooked by [[Mount Dodild]] and the [[Breakback Pass]].

popup.title: Wet River
popup.description: A waterway that began on the slopes of the [[Orsraun Mountains]], emptying into the [[Long Arm Lake]].

popup.title: Shalane Lake
popup.description: The northwestern narrow part of the [[Deepwash]] connected to the [[Impresk Lake]] via the [[Shalane River]].

popup.title: Deepwash
popup.description: The largest freshwater lake in the [[Vilhon Reach]], filled by tributaries from the [[Cloven Mountains]] and the [[Deepwing Mountains]].

popup.title: Tun River
popup.description: An expansive waterway surrounded by the floodplains unsuitable for farmland.

popup.title: Falls of Tumbling Stars
popup.description: A waterfall and hidden mountain valley in the [[Thunder Peaks]] at the beginning of the [[Immerflow]] river.

popup.title: Lake Sember
popup.description: A medium-sized freshwater lake and the location of [[Hyaline]], an ancient [[sea elf]] city and the [[Crystalline Towers]].

popup.title: Immerflow
popup.description: The northeastern tributary that fed the [[Wyvernwater]].

popup.title: Thunder River
popup.description: Or '''Thunderflow''', a busy waterway used for trade between [[Cormyr]], the village of [[Hultail]], and the [[Dalelands]].

popup.title: Wyvernwater
popup.description: The star-shaped freshwater lake at the center of [[Cormyr]], connected to the [[Dragonmere]] via the [[Wyvernflow]].

popup.title: Wyvernflow
popup.description: The river that flowed from the [[Wyvernwater]] lake into the [[Dragonmere]].

popup.title: Darkflow River
popup.description: A slow and short river in the [[Vast Swamp]] with dark inky waters.

popup.title: The Neck
popup.description: The canal between the [[Dragonmere]] and the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]].

popup.title: River Thunn
popup.description: The waterway that ran from the high lands of the [[Dragon Coast]] down into the harbor of the city of [[Westgate]] on the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]].

popup.title: Skoond's Run
popup.description: The strait that separated the island of [[Thelve]] from the three islands to the south – [[Arthoum]], [[Nairn's Tomb]], and [[Askalet]].

popup.title: Racewind Passage
popup.description: The strait between [[Thelve]], [[Askalet]] and the [[Sword Coast]] mainland that was known for its swift winds during the day and wet fog at night.

popup.title: Cauldron of the Reach
popup.description: The cartographic name given to the hazardous waters between the isle of [[Thelve]] and the trio of islands known as the [[Crab Reach]].

popup.title: Borlyth Bay
popup.description: A small bay with rocky shores named after the monster-infested village of [[Borlyth]] on its northern shore.

popup.title: Cloak Bay
popup.description: Also known as '''Raetheless'' among the [[Fair Folk]], one of the two bays just south of the [[Cloakwood]].

popup.title: Lake Eredruie
popup.description: An exceptionally beautiful pool fed by the [[Glaemril]] river, protected by the [[moon elves]] of [[Bristar]].{{approx}}

popup.title: River Arkhen
popup.description: Also known as the '''River Elzimmer''', it was fed by the [[Arkhen Falls]], which emerged from [[Mount Thalagbror]], in the [[Thunder Peaks]].

popup.title: Arkhen Falls
popup.description: The largest and most beautiful waterfall in all of the [[Dalelands]], formed by a spring shooting out from [[Mount Thalagbror]] and cascading down the southern face of the northern ridge of the [[Thunder Peaks]].

popup.title: Starwater River
popup.description: A major waterway of treacherous sandbars, which made it dangerous to those who were not familiar with them.

popup.title: Dragonmere
popup.description: Or the '''Lake of Dragons''', a large saltwater lake connected to the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] with its shores belonging to [[Cormyr]], [[Sembia]], and the [[Dragon Coast]].

popup.title: River Arabel
popup.description: Also known as the '''Sword River''', a river that began in the [[Storm Horns]] and fed the [[Wyvernwater]] from the northwest.

popup.title: The Warm Waterfall
popup.description: The waterfall that birthed [[Starwater]]s western tributary.

popup.title: Plungepool
popup.description: A pond of note in the [[King's Forest]].

popup.title: River Sharragh
popup.description: A small forest river that fed the [[Plungepool]].

popup.title: Redwater Lake
popup.description: The lake that was fed by the [[Lake of the Snake]] by means of the [[River Reddan]].

popup.title: Lake of the Snake
popup.description: A small lake on the [[Dragon Coast]], south of the [[Horse Prairie]] and east of the [[Giant's Run]].

popup.title: River Reddan
popup.description: The river that ran east by northeast from the [[Lake of the Snake]] towards the [[Redwater]].

popup.title: River Lurlar
popup.description: A humble waterway of note.

popup.title: Lake of the Long Arm
popup.description: A vast lake found in the [[Dragon Coast]] region with the [[Shou]] nation of [[Nathlan]] located on its souther shores.

popup.title: Castaway Coast
popup.description: A section of coastline along the [[Dragonmere]] between the towns of [[Pros]] and [[Teziir]].

popup.title: The Skeleton Shore
popup.description: The coastline along the [[Dragonmere]] that stretched from [[Teziir]] in the west all the way to [[Westgate]].

popup.title: Winding Water
popup.description: The river that flowed from several tributaries as far away as the [[Marsh of Chelimber]], and eventually flowed into the [[Sea of Swords]] south of the [[Troll Hills]].

popup.title: Misty Stair
popup.description: Waterfalls that birthed [[River Reaching]] in the [[Sunset Mountains]].

popup.title: Serpent's Tail Stream
popup.description: A flooding river stream lined with gravel that ran through [[Najara]] in the [[Western Heartlands]].

popup.title: River Reaching
popup.description: The waterway that began in the [[Sunset Mountains]], flowed through the [[Skull Gorge]], entered the [[Reaching Woods]], and finally emerged to pour into the [[River Chionthar]] near [[Scornubel]].

popup.title: Highstar Lake
popup.description: A legendary body of water located in the [[Delimbiyr Vale]], known for many mystifying appearances and mysterious disappearances.

popup.title: Hark River
popup.description: The waterway that fed the [[Highstar Lake]] from the west, sprouting off the [[Delimbiyr River]].

popup.title: Grayflow
popup.description: The waterway that began in the [[Graypeak Mountains]], ran northward toward [[Llorkh]], before veering west. It was joined by the river [[Loagrann]] south of [[Orlbar]], and then flowed into the [[Delimbiyr River]] with a confluence at [[Loudwater]].

popup.title: Loagrann River
popup.description: The river that was formed by the joining of three tributaries—two of which were named [[Skull Creek]] and [[Whitewater]]—flowed from the northern part of the [[Greypeak Mountains]].

popup.title: Skull Creek
popup.description: One of the three tributaries of the [[Loagrann River]] that cascaded from the northern part of the [[Greypeak Mountains]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Whitewater
popup.description: One of the three tributaries of the [[Loagrann River]] that cascaded from the northern part of the [[Greypeak Mountains]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Heartblood River
popup.description: The river that started somewhere in the [[Star Mounts]] and joined the river [[Delimbiyr]] just off the eastern edge of the [[High Forest]].

popup.title: Shining Falls
popup.description: A stunningly beautiful waterfall in the [[Graypeak Mountains]] that formed part of the [[River Delimbiyr]] and marked the beginning of the [[Delimbiyr Vale]].

popup.title: Mistwater River
popup.description: I minor waterway with two tributaries: the [[Evenbrook]] by the hamlet of [[Gorthin]] and the [[Kirinar Stream]] south of [[Kirinwood]].

popup.title: Kirinar Stream
popup.description: One of the [[Mistwater River]]'s tributaries.

popup.title: Evenbrook
popup.description: One of the [[Mistwater River]]'s tributaries.

popup.title: Starmantle Bay
popup.description: The bay that stretched from [[Starmantle]] to the east.

popup.title: Cedar River
popup.description: A waterway that passed through the [[Gulthmere Forest]] used by merchants and traders of [[Cedarspoke]].

popup.title: South Cedar River
popup.description: Also known as the '''Xian River''', the southern tributary of the [[Cedar River]].

popup.title: North Cedar River
popup.description: The northern tributary of the [[Cedar River]].

popup.title: Churning Bay
popup.description: The violent gulf on the Vilhon Reach, where the city of [[Hlondeth]] was founded.

popup.title: Lightless Lake
popup.description: Also known as the '''Moonmere''', the lake that hid the [[Fane of Shadows]] dedicated to [[Shar]].

popup.title: Arabel Springs
popup.description: The source of the [[River Arabel]], located in the hills just southeast of [[Arabel]] city.

popup.title: Lake of Drifting Stars
popup.description: A freshwater lake and a popular rendezvous spot for lovers who sought a romantic encounter during the [[Feast of the Moon]].

popup.title: Alaoreum River
popup.description: A flooding river that began in the [[Mountains of the Alaoreum]], ran south along the shoreline of the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]], and ended in [[Evenstar Lake]].

popup.title: Evenstar Lake
popup.description: The lake fed by the [[Alaoreum River]] in the [[Evenstar Vale]], surrounded by dense forests.

popup.title: River Lis
popup.description: Known as '''the Blood River''' by [[orc]]s, a shallow swampy river connecting the [[Moonsea]] to the [[Dragon Reach]].

popup.title: Bay of Phlan
popup.description: The bay on the [[Stojanow]] river where the city-state of [[Phlan]] stood.

popup.title: Stojanow
popup.description: Also known as the '''Barren River''', used to transport ore and minerals from the [[Dragonspines]] to the cities of [[Phlan]] and from there – to [[Melvaunt]].

popup.title: Ardeep River
popup.description: The river that originated in the [[Ardeep Forest]] and flowed to the [[Sea of Swords]], where it forked into three branches forming a small delta.

popup.title: Selpir
popup.description: A slow and quiet creek that forked from the [[Ardeep River]] and the [[South Ardeep River]].

popup.title: Yhauntan Bay
popup.description: The bay where the city of [[Yhaunn]] stood, between the [[Dragon Reach]] and the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]].

popup.title: River Dalton
popup.description: The river that branched to the east from the [[River Lis]] and flowed east then south along a dense forest before emptying into the swampland of the [[Flooded Forest]].

popup.title: Stormy Bay
popup.description: A broad inlet that formed along the northern coast of the [[Moonsea]], within which was a secluded isle that housed a small fishing village and a hidden camp of pirate slavers.

popup.title: Lake Melishar
popup.description: A clear, cool lake in the middle of the [[Spiderhaunt Wood]] with the [[Nature's Inn]] perched on its shores.

popup.title: River Dessarin
popup.description: A major cold river that flowed through the [[Savage Frontier]], flowing from the [[Dancing Falls]] at the base of the [[Lost Peaks]].

popup.title: Dancing Falls
popup.description: The beginning of the cold northern [[River Dessarin]].

popup.title: Gaustar's Creek
popup.description: A long, swift-flowing stream in the [[Dessarin Valley]] and a tributary of the [[River Dessarin]].

popup.title: Tormel River
popup.description: A waterway found in the land of [[Thar]] that originated in the body of water referred to as [[Bloodmuck]] and flowed southwest, passing by the city of [[Melvaunt]] before emptying into the [[Moonsea]].

popup.title: River Thent
popup.description: A river that originated from [[Lake Thentar]] in the Great Grey Land of [[Thar]], and flowed southward into the [[Moonsea]] lake.

popup.title: Lake Thentar
popup.description: A small lake from where the [[River Thent]] originated.

popup.title: Jaws Strait
popup.description: Or simply '''The Jaws''', a small straight found within the [[Pirate Isles]], near the islands of [[Teltar]] and [[Sarr]].

popup.title: The Bowl
popup.description: An open area of the deep sea found in the center of the [[Pirate Isles]].

popup.title: The Windrace
popup.description: A prominent strait that stretched roughly from the [[Bowl]] in the south to [[Alphar Isle]] in the north.

popup.title: The Spoon
popup.description: A small strait found within the [[Pirate Isles]] situated in the east and northeast region; it ran along the southern edge of the [[Alphar Isle]] and the eastern shore of [[Ilthan]] and bordered [[the Bowl]] to the south.

popup.title: Moonsea
popup.description: Also known as the '''Dragon Sea''', a deep [[amethyst]]-colored natural lake just north of [[Cormanthor]].

popup.title: Dragon Reach
popup.description: The northwestern fjord of the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] that stretched between [[the Vast]] and the [[Dalelands]]; the location of [[Selu'Maraar]] kingdom of [[aquatic elves]].

popup.title: Winterspear River
popup.description: A waterway that originated in the [[Galena Mountains]] from several tributaries, moved north, passing a lake and draining into the [[Moonsea]] at the city of [[Hulburg]].

popup.title: Trank River
popup.description: A calm minor waterway with seldom-encountered rushing rapids that originated in the [[Vanishing Hills]] and drained into the [[Twilight Marsh]].

popup.title: Duathamper
popup.description: Also known as the '''Elvenflow''', one of two major rivers running through [[Cormanthor]], deep and wide waterway spanned by three black [[granite]] bridges.

popup.title: Fire River
popup.description: A wide and mostly placid river that flowed west across the southern [[Vast]] with its only major cataract being a thundering waterfall near the village of [[Dragon Falls]].

popup.title: River Vesper
popup.description: A cold and clear river that began in a long series of heavy waterfalls and rocky cascades.

popup.title: Dragon Falls Waterfall
popup.description: The waterfall that began at a spring and cascaded over a bluff alongside the [[North Road]], before joining the [[Fire River]].

popup.title: River Tesh
popup.description: The river that flowed from the [[Desertsmouth Mountains]] in the [[Dalelands]] down to the western edge of the [[Moonsea]]. The lands around the river were known as the [[Tesh Valley]].

popup.title: River Ashaba
popup.description: Also known as the '''River Verire''' or '''Dagger River'''.

popup.title: Pool of Yeven
popup.description: A small lake found within the [[Yevenwood]] in [[Battledale]].

popup.title: Semberflow
popup.description: A minor waterway that flowed from [[Lake Sember]] to the [[River Ashaba]], guarded by [[aquatic elven]] [[warrior]]s.

popup.title: Glaemril
popup.description: Also known as the '''Deeping Stream''', a small river that started in the southern spur of the woods of [[Cormanthor]] at [[Lake Eredruie]] and flowed into the [[River Ashaba]].

popup.title: Feather Falls
popup.description: A waterfall, a natural landmark that indicated the border between [[Featherdale]] and [[Scardale]].

popup.title: White River
popup.description: A small frigid river found in the [[Earthspur Mountains]] that flowed down from the [[Glacier of the White Worm]].

popup.title: The Tunwash
popup.description: A minor waterway that drained into the [[Marsh of Tun]].

popup.title: Teerac
popup.description: A body of water of note in the [[Stonelands]].

popup.title: Lake Miir
popup.description: The lake where cities of [[Helvara]] stood with its waters inhabited by [[blue-scaled brench]] and [[spicy crabfin]].

popup.title: River Redrun
popup.description: The waterway that began in the [[Druarwood]] and flowed southeast past the [[Moonwood]] and the [[Night Trees]] through the [[Moonlands]]. It flowed past [[Citadel Felbarr]] and joined another river from the [[Rauvin Mountains]] to form the [[River Rauvin]] in the [[Sundabar Vale]].

popup.title: River Rauvin
popup.description: The cold waterway that began in the [[Rauvin Mountains]] and merged into the [[River Surbrin]] and eventually drained into the [[Dessarin River]] and out to the [[Sea of Swords]].

popup.title: Dead Orc River
popup.description: Also known as '''Orc Creek''', a tribunary of [[River Rauvin]].

popup.title: Falls of Ixce
popup.description: A waterfall of note there the [[Telstang Brook]] began.

popup.title: Lake Longreach
popup.description: A closed lake found in the [[Moonsea North]], fed from three streams that flowed down from the nearby mountains, the [[Telstang Brook]], [[Naed Creek]], and [[Razack's Tears]].

popup.title: Naed Creek
popup.description: A stream that originated in the [[Valley of the Falls]] and snaked west towards the [[Lake Longreach]].

popup.title: Telstang Brook
popup.description: A long stream that flowed northwest from the [[West Galena Mountains]], west through [[Vercy Wood]], before joining with [[Razack's Tears]] and emptying into Lake Longreach.

popup.title: River Samar
popup.description: The only major river within the kingdom of [[Samarach]] that originated in the [[Sanrach Mountains]].

popup.title: Bay of Omgar
popup.description: A bay bordered by the [[Snout of Omgar]] peninsula.

popup.title: Samar Bay
popup.description: A smaller bay in the [[Bay of Omgar]], where  [[Samargol]]'s docks were built.

popup.title: Snapping Turtle Bay
popup.description: A bay of note on the [[Wild Coast]] of [[Chult]].

popup.title: River Gur
popup.description: A small river found in [[Thindol]] used for trade.

popup.title: Rassatan Bay
popup.description: The bay at the foothills of the [[City of Gilded Pearls]], rich with golden [[pearl]]s and [[oyster]]s.

popup.title: River Tching
popup.description: A small river was formed from numerous creeks originating in the [[Tching Mountains]], near [[Tchinggult]], flowed south and east to empty into the [[Thingulph]] south of [[Lundeth]].

popup.title: River Salban
popup.description: A small river that originated in an underground spring within the [[Sanrach Mountains]].

popup.title: Salban Falls
popup.description: A massive waterfall, part of the [[River Salban]], where it plummeted off a cliff overlooking the grasslands below.

popup.title: Selgaunt Bay
popup.description: The bay of [[Selgaunt]] where the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] touched the city, and the [[River Arkhen]] drained into the sea.

popup.title: Bay of Chult
popup.description: A bay fed by the Rivers [[Soshenstar]] and [[Tiryki]] and the location of [[Port Nyanzaru]].

popup.title: Jahaka Bay
popup.description: A coastal inlet fed by the [[River Tath]] tha spanned 20 miles across and twice that distance inland.

popup.title: Refuge Bay
popup.description: A large bay in [[Chult]] that began south of [[Port Castigliar]], stretch to [[Ishau]] and was bordered by the [[Dawn Warrior]] island to the east.

popup.title: The Talons
popup.description: The forked tributaries of the [[River Delimbiyr]].

popup.title: Striding Giant Rapids
popup.description: A section of rapids located around a [[petrified]] [[giant]] in the middle of the [[River Rauvin]], just downriver from [[Everlund]].

popup.title: The Laughingflow
popup.description: Also known as the '''Trollflow'' in [[Nesmé]], a tributary of the [[River Surbrin]].

popup.title: Unicorn Run
popup.description: A river that started in the [[Star Mounts]] and joined the river [[Delimbiyr]] near [[Secomber]], its every natural race was said to have emerged from the womb of [[Chauntea]] onto [[Toril]].

popup.title: The Sisters
popup.description: A set of waterfalls running over cliffs south of the [[Star Mounts]]; seeing the [[moon]] rise over the Sisters and glimpse a [[unicorn]] atop a cliff was considered a blessing of good fortune from the goddess [[Mielikki]].

popup.title: North Fork
popup.description: A shorter tributary of the [[Unicorn Run]].

popup.title: Starsilver
popup.description: A tributary of the river [[Delimbiyr]] and one of [[The Talons]], on which [[Myth Glaurach]], the City of Scrolls once stood.

popup.title: River Mhair
popup.description: A waterway located in the [[Mhair Jungles]] that fed the [[Lapal Sea]]'s eastern side.

popup.title: River Lemas
popup.description: The waterway that connected [[Lake Lemas]] with the [[Lapal Sea]].

popup.title: Lake Lemas
popup.description: A jungle lake connected to the [[Lapal Sea]] via the [[River Lemas]].

popup.title: River Tharynd
popup.description: The river that was born in the [[Delphin Mountains]] and fed the [[Lapal Sea]]'s northern side.

popup.title: Tashtan Coast
popup.description: The coastline in [[Tashalar]].

popup.title: River Lundeth
popup.description: Also called the '''Cascades'' because of its turbulent flow.

popup.title: Lake Luo
popup.description: An alkaline lake located in the [[Valley of Embers]] that fed the [[River Olung]].

popup.title: Horn Stream
popup.description: A tributary of the [[River Surbrin]].

popup.title: River Mirar
popup.description: Also known as the '''Tanlur''' to the ancient [[dwarves]], a cold waterway that began in the [[Spine of the World]], ran through the [[Valley of Khedrun]], until finally ending in [[Luskan]].

popup.title: River Soshenstar
popup.description: One of the three great rivers of [[Chult]], often used for travel by canoe, and it poured over a waterfall about every ten or fifteen miles on its journey to the sea.

popup.title: River Tiryki
popup.description: A minor river that flowed north from the back of a mist-shrouded canyon into the [[Bay of Chult]] near [[Port Nyanzaru]]; it was considered by many to be perhaps the most dangerous river in all of [[Chult]].

popup.title: Kitcher's Inlet
popup.description: A minor inlet on the northern edge of the greater [[Refuge Bay]].

popup.title: River Olung
popup.description: A major river inhabited by [[aldani]] and home to ''[[bara]]'' [[Mainu]], who appeared as a patch of darkness with golden eyes to those who saw her.

popup.description: Also spelled '''Mortick Swamp''', inhabited by monsters, namely [[merrow]] and [[scrag]]s, which often raided nearby lands.

popup.title: Great Swamp of Rethild
popup.description: Also known as the '''Great Swamp''' or ''Rethild'' and ''Kethid,''' a swamp in [[Dambrath]] filled with dangerous creatures and diseases like [[cackle fever]] and [[mindfire]].

popup.title: Lhespenbog
popup.description: A small wetland of sprawling [[reed]]-fields used in creation of the [[enchanted]] [[staves]] – ''[[Aiedo wither-stick]]s''.

popup.title: Kilmaruu Swamp
popup.description: A stretch of [[undead]]-infested swamp and marshland where a ruined city stood. The swamp was the topic of the infamous [[Halruaa]]n strategic ''[[Kilmaruu Paradox]]''.

popup.title: Swamp of Akhlaur
popup.description: Also known as the '''Swamp of Ghalagar''', was a magically created swamp from a ''[[gate]]'' to the [[Elemental Plane of Water]], closed permanently in [[1373 DR]].

popup.title: Spider Swamp
popup.description: The fetid swamp, formed by a great [[marid]]'s death in the [[Steam Clashes]] of [[−7687 DR]].

popup.title: Umber Marsh
popup.description: A large patch of boggy land on the border of [[Aglarond]] and [[Thay]], virtually impassible with many small springs and streams running across the wetlands, and eventually daring into [[River Lapendrar]].

popup.title: Surmarsh
popup.description: A dreary, humid swamp with its stench being especially wretched during the summer.

popup.title: Zehoarast Floodplains
popup.description: The floodplains that encompassed the lowlands between the [[River Esmel]] and the [[Small Teeth]] and west of the [[Trade Way]].

popup.title: Wetwoods
popup.description: Also known as the '''Flooded Forest''', a misty bog of [[fungus]]-coated trees.

popup.title: Farsea Marshes
popup.description: A wetland that once was home to an ancient civilization lost to time. The remnants of their astonishingly resilient structures were buried beneath the wetlands.

popup.title: Vast Swamp
popup.description: A dangerous swamp populated by tribes of [[lizardfolk]], [[hobgoblin]]s, and other [[goblinoid]]s, [[orc]]s, [[gnoll]]s, and [[troll]]s.

popup.title: Marsh of Tun
popup.description: Also known as the '''Fens of Tun''', a moderate-weather swamp lying in the [[Tunlands]] between the [[Sunset Mountains]] and the [[Stormhorns]].

popup.title: Gritstone Moorland
popup.description: A region of wetlands found on the eastern stretch of the [[Dragon Coast]] in the [[Eastern Heartlands]].

popup.title: Nameless Swamp
popup.description: A wetland of note.

popup.title: Lizard Marsh
popup.description: A large [[lizardfolk]], giant insect, [[black dragon]]-infested bayou in the delta of the [[Delimbiyr]] river.

popup.title: High Moor
popup.description: A large, monster-infested, open moorland in [[western Faerûn]], created in about [[-10500 DR]] when the kingdom of [[Miyeritar]] fell.

popup.title: Marsh of Chelimber
popup.description: A marsh or pungent [[sulfur]]ous steam pools inhabited by numerous [[lizardfolk]], [[bullywug]]s, and [[siv]]s.

popup.title: Stump Bog
popup.description: A bog to the east of the hamlet of [[Rassalantar]], inhabited by [[giant crab]]s, [[giant crayfish]], [[giant eel]]s, [[giant frog]]s, [[giant leech]]es, [[giant lizard]]s, [[giant wasp]]s, and [[giant slug]]s.

popup.title: Twilight Marsh
popup.description: A coastal swamp typically blanketed with heavy rain and thick fog in the early hours of the morning, fed by the waters of the [[Trank River]].

popup.title: Glumpen Swamp
popup.description: The waters of the swamp amidst barren lands originated from the [[Lake Longreach]] found to the northwest in [[the Ride]].

popup.title: Flooded Forest
popup.description: A section of the great forest of [[Cormanthor]] that laid beyond the [[River Lis]], flooded and transformed into a swamp home of [[lizardfolk]] and [[black dragon]]s.

popup.title: Glaun Bog
popup.description: A swamp of note, to the south of [[Sun Hills]].

popup.title: Glumpen Swamp
popup.description: The swamp fed by the waters of the swamp originated from [[Lake Longreach]] found to the northwest in the [[Ride]].

popup.title: Altispinax Swamp
popup.description: A dangerous swamp, homeland of predatory [[altispinax]] [[dinosaur]]s.

popup.title: Lonely Moor
popup.description: Area of boggy terrain occupied by bands of [[gnoll]]s and [[bugbear]]s.

popup.title: Cold Marshes
popup.description: Small frigid marshland adjacent to the [[Fell Woods]], infested with [[spider]]s, [[ettercap]]s, [[wyvern]]s, [[snow troll]]s, and frequented by [[barbarian]]s of the north.

popup.title: Bottomless Bogs
popup.description: An extensive area of cold swampland, foul mires, and smelly lakes in northwestern [[Vaasa]].

popup.title: Mere of Dead Men
popup.description:
Also known as '''Merdelain''', meaning "Slow Marching Court" in [[Elvish]]; the swamp's sinister name referred to the thousands of [[dwarves]], [[elves]], and [[human]]s of the [[Fallen Kingdom]] who were slain here during the invasion of an [[orc]] army in [[
615 DR]].

popup.title: Codsbay Mire
popup.description: A wetland where the [[Codsrun Creek]] delta met the [[Strait of Oman]].

popup.title: Leechhome
popup.description: A swamp of note.

popup.title: Drowned Forest
popup.description: Also known as the '''Browned Forest''', a marshland located in the kingdom of [[Callidyrr]].

popup.title: Tearglade
popup.description: A marshland located along the eastern shore on the [[Sea of Swords]] where the [[Swanmay River]] met the sea.

popup.title: Taeya Bog
popup.description: A coastal marshland of note.

popup.title: Black Maw Bog
popup.description: A small bog with a bridge that allowed the [[Long Road]] to cross over.

popup.title: Fens of the Fallen
popup.description: Wetlands of note.

popup.title: Mere Adammair
popup.description: A small marshland of note.

popup.title: Maloren Sods
popup.description: A large coastal swamp on the island of [[Snowdown]].

popup.title: Meirig Peatlands
popup.description: A large peat swamp.

popup.title: Breasal Marsh
popup.description: A peat-rich marshland inhabited by various tribes of [[lizardfolk]].

popup.title: The Frostfenn
popup.description: A large marshland of note.
